_readme: Copy to data/watchlist.json (the /onboard skill builds it with you).
Your company watchlist: employers you actively want to work for. Roles at
these companies are prioritised for full tailoring, and their career
boards can be checked directly (careers_url) beyond the LinkedIn crawl.
Grow it over time: just ask Claude to 'add <company> to my watchlist',
or edit this file by hand. Set check_daily to false to keep a company
on the list without checking its board every run.
Shared by both tracker backends; with the Notion backend, rows from a
Notion Company Watchlist database (if configured) are merged in too.
